children: Allen, who took over as CEO in July, purchased the shares on Tuesday at an average price of 682p each, for a total value of £98,890.
As of 1535 BST, Hilton Food shares were up 1.79% at 690.15p.
Reporting by Iain Gilbert at Sharecast.com
